title: Scheming-Eval Leakage Auditor for Training-Data Contamination

original_idea.body: # Scheming-Eval Leakage Auditor. Probe whether open models recognize/complete canonical scheming scenarios via canary checks, completion overlap, recall probes; report contamination indicators per model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Contamination silently invalidates scheming-eval conclusions; auditor protects safety-eval integrity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Canary/completion-overlap probing of open models; accessible, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused auditor + contamination report; assembling probe methods is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Benchmark-integrity tool over public scenarios; labs underweight, third-party value.

novelty.reasoning: Contamination auditing is standard elsewhere but underapplied to scheming evals; plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Standard method underapplied to scheming evals; angle plausibly open.
